text:
emma_cs: Quick heads-up — VegaCorp renewal signed but procurement surfaced a billing-entity cutover. They need the PO issued to a new legal entity before we can collect.
raj_sales: Ah ok. Did they send the new vendor details?
emma_cs: Yep — attached in the thread from their procurement contact. PO needs to be to ‘Vega Holdings UK Ltd’, tax ID included.
linda_legal: Flag — the signer on the current SOW is a director at the old entity. We need either a delegated signer with authority or a re-signed SOW from the new entity.
oliver_finance: If procurement wants us invoiced to the new entity, we also need a new PO number and the vendor code updated. Can they provide a PO before e-sign?
emma_cs: They said procurement can issue PO but will only do so once legal confirms the signer mapping. So looped in both.
raj_sales: I can ask the customer for a delegated signer email. If they confirm, we can accept a delegation letter + PO.
linda_legal: Delegation letter is fine but must include explicit signature authority language and date range. Ask them to route via their legal or finance.
emma_cs: Sending suggested delegation template now: `https://redwood.internal/templates/delegation-letter.docx`
raj_sales: Pinged their procurement — requested delegation + PO by EOD their timezone.
odocusign_bot: docusign-bot: VegaCorp SOW (v3) was sent for signature to james@vegacorp.com at 2024-05-02T14:12Z
emma_cs: Important — docusign was sent to James at old entity. We should pause that envelope until we confirm the signer/PO combo. Linda, can you advise whether we should void and resend?
linda_legal: Void the existing envelope. We don't want a partially executed SOW that ties to the wrong entity. I'll draft guidance on the exact language procurement must include.
oliver_finance: Once PO is reissued, finance will match PO -> invoice -> vendor code. If they change VAT treatment we may need tax team signoff too.
raj_sales: Customer replied: "we can sign with delegated approver Sarah (sarah@vegaholdings.co.uk) and will issue PO #VH-2024-998 by EOD GMT."
emma_cs: Great. Sarah's title is listed as Head of Finance on LinkedIn, looks fine. I'll request a scanned delegation letter on company letterhead.
linda_legal: If delegation letter arrives, include exact legal entity name and tax ID. I'll confirm language asap.
odocusign_bot: docusign-bot: Envelope VG-998 voided by emma_cs at 2024-05-02T15:04Z
emma_cs: Voided the old envelope and told procurement to wait.
raj_sales: Also asked them to cc both finance and legal on the PO email so we have the trail.
oliver_finance: FYI — if PO arrives with a different VAT clause, we might need to issue a credit and re-invoice. Will confirm once PO received.
emma_cs: They just uploaded the delegation letter and PO to the docsend link: `https://docsend.com/view/vegacorp-renewal-attachments`
linda_legal: Reviewing delegation now. Quick note: it lists "delegated authority: sign commercial agreements up to £250k" which covers our renewal. Approving.
oliver_finance: PO #VH-2024-998 received, vendor code request submitted to billing ops.
emma_cs: Re-sending SOW for signature to sarah@vegaholdings.co.uk with the updated billing entity. Please confirm once signed.
odocusign_bot: docusign-bot: New envelope VG-999 sent to sarah@vegaholdings.co.uk at 2024-05-02T17:22Z
raj_sales: Thx — I'll confirm payment terms with procurement (they requested Net30 on the new entity).
oliver_finance: Net30 okay, but note this will shift cash timing — flagging to AR.
linda_legal: Once signed, I'll attach the delegation letter to the contract file and close the loop.
emma_cs: Sarah signed at 2024-05-02T18:01Z.
odocusign_bot: docusign-bot: Envelope VG-999 completed by sarah@vegaholdings.co.uk at 2024-05-02T18:01Z
oliver_finance: Invoice issued to Vega Holdings UK Ltd, PO VH-2024-998, amount matches renewal. Charging under vendor code VH-UK-03.
emma_cs: Closing note — renewal executed under new entity, docs archived, finance updated vendor code, no further action. Thanks all :tada:
raj_sales: Great outcome. Please add a short note in Gainsight so CSM future-proof handoffs.
emma_cs: Will do. Added Gainsight note and uploaded signed SOW + delegation letter.
